Ahmed Fatouh.note: Fatouh has been part of Egypt's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Ahmed Fatouh.noteZh: 他给Egypt后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Emam Ashour.note: Ashour gives Egypt a scorer opponents now have to carry in their heads. His goals against Belgium and Australia make every loose ball feel heavier.
Emam Ashour.noteZh: 他让Egypt拥有一个必须被惦记的得分点。每个松散球都可能突然变重。

Haissem Hassan.note: Hassan has one tournament assist in the bank for Egypt. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Haissem Hassan.noteZh: 他已经帮Egypt制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Hamdy Fathy.note: Fathy gives Egypt structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Hamdy Fathy.noteZh: 他给Egypt控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Hamza Abdelkarim.note: Abdelkarim is attacking depth for Egypt. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Hamza Abdelkarim.noteZh: 他是Egypt前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Hossam Abdelmaguid.note: Abdelmaguid gives Egypt cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Hossam Abdelmaguid.noteZh: 他是Egypt后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Ibrahim Adel.note: Adel gives Egypt a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Ibrahim Adel.noteZh: 他是Egypt在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Karim Hafez.note: Hafez has supplied one of Egypt's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Karim Hafez.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Egypt创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Mahdy Soliman.note: Soliman gives Egypt a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Mahdy Soliman.noteZh: 他在Egypt首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Mahmoud Saber.note: Saber is on the scoresheet for Egypt, with his goal coming against IR Iran. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Mahmoud Saber.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Marawan Attia.note: Attia has supplied one of Egypt's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Marawan Attia.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Egypt创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Mohamed Abdelmoneim.summary: Mohamed Abdelmoneim is an Egypt centre-back from OGC Nice who gives the national team front-foot defending, aerial power, and aggressive stepping.
Mohamed Abdelmoneim.note: Abdelmonem gives Egypt cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Mohamed Abdelmoneim.noteZh: 他是Egypt后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Mohamed Alaa.note: Alaa is Egypt's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Mohamed Alaa.noteZh: 他是Egypt的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Mohamed El Shenawy.note: Shenawy sits behind the starter for Egypt, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Mohamed El Shenawy.noteZh: 他给Egypt保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Mohamed Hany.note: Hany has already created a goal for Egypt in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Mohamed Hany.noteZh: 他已经参与了Egypt的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Mohamed Salah.note: Salah has both scored and created for Egypt in this run. He matters because the same movement can become the shot or the pass before it.
Mohamed Salah.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Egypt贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Mohanad Lashin.summary: Mohanad Lashin is an Egypt defensive midfielder from Pyramids FC who gives the national team central coverage, ball winning, and simple progression.
Mohanad Lashin.note: Lasheen gives Egypt structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Mohanad Lashin.noteZh: 他给Egypt控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Mostafa Shoubir.summary: Mostafa Shoubir is an Egypt goalkeeper from Al Ahly who gives the national team reaction saves, line command, and close-range stops.
Mostafa Shoubir.note: Shobeir is the last voice in Egypt's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Mostafa Shoubir.noteZh: 他承担了Egypt的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Mostafa Zico.note: Ziko has put goals and service into Egypt's tournament, with finishes against New Zealand and Argentina. His card is the next action after the first touch.
Mostafa Zico.noteZh: 他已经用进球和助攻塑造了Egypt的这届世界杯。注意他的第一脚触球之后，下一步动作来得有多快。

Nabil Donga.note: Emad gives Egypt a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Nabil Donga.noteZh: 他是Egypt的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Omar Marmoush.note: Marmoush is one of Egypt's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Omar Marmoush.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对Egypt来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Ramy Rabia.note: Rabia is in the quiet-work part of Egypt's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Ramy Rabia.noteZh: 他是Egypt主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Tarek Alaa.summary: Tarek Alaa is an Egypt right-back from ZED FC who gives the national team right-side defending, overlap energy, and recovery runs.
Tarek Alaa.note: Alaa is defensive cover for Egypt's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Tarek Alaa.noteZh: 他是Egypt在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Trezeguet.note: Trézéguet has already given Egypt a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Trezeguet.noteZh: 他给Egypt展示了进攻工作的两面。一脚拉开防守，下一脚就可能决定机会。

Yasser Ibrahim.note: Ibrahim already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Argentina. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Yasser Ibrahim.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Zizo.note: Zizo is one of Egypt's named attacking routes in this tournament. His job is to make the first defender move so the finish or final pass can appear.
Zizo.noteZh: 他给Egypt一种把控球变成压力的路线。他要让防守者必须做选择。
